meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能为 NanoClaw 在 macOS 菜单栏添加状态指示器：显示一个闪电图标，用绿/红点表示 NanoClaw 是否在运行，并提供启动、停止、重启等控制。
howto.when: 当用户在 macOS 上要求为 NanoClaw 添加菜单栏状态指示器，或提到“状态栏”“菜单栏”“NanoClaw 状态”等时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加 macOS 菜单栏状态图标。
say.note: Claude 会检查环境并安装状态栏程序。

say.text: 帮我在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 的运行状态。
say.note: 会编译 Swift 并添加闪电图标。

say.text: 安装 NanoClaw 的菜单栏状态指示器。
say.note: 菜单栏出现图标，可点开控制启动/停止。

howto.what_en: Adds a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw: a bolt icon with a green/red dot showing whether NanoClaw is running, plus Start, Stop, and Restart controls.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add a menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw on macOS, or mentions “status bar”, “menu bar”, or “NanoClaw status”.

say_en.text: Add a macOS menu bar status icon for NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Claude checks the environment and installs the status bar app.

say_en.text: Show NanoClaw's running status in the menu bar.
say_en.note: Compiles the Swift binary and adds the bolt icon.

say_en.text: Install the NanoClaw menu bar status indicator.
say_en.note: An icon appears in the menu bar with start/stop controls.
